name: commie-doge
title: Commie Doge
author: xrisk
description: Reskins the engineer as a comrade Shiba ('doge'): a full 8-direction animated waddle, a curled tail, a player-colored cap with a gold star and hammer & sickle, and a green toy water pistol when armed. The cap fill and chest take your chosen player color; the insignia stays gold. Data-only reskin, so enable only one character skin at a time.
